method: Openverse API (license=cc0,by) for Freesound items, curated by category and duration; every file URL range-requested with curl; packs downloaded and listed.

sources.name: Kenney (kenney.nl) audio packs
sources.api: No API. Zip links are signed and expire: GET https://kenney.nl/assets/<slug> with a cookie jar, then GET https://kenney.nl/download-link/<hex(assets/<slug>)> with the same cookies and Referer; the JSON 'url' field is a signed zip URL (expires param). Without the session cookie the endpoint returns {"error":"forbidden"}.
sources.notes: Best fit for UI work: Interface Sounds (100) and UI Audio (50) cover click, tap, toggle, switch, select, confirm, error, glitch, scroll, tick. Each zip has License.txt stating CC0. Files are .ogg. CC0 means they may be committed to a public repo; the same packs are also mirrored on OpenGameArt (stable URLs, e.g. UI_SFX_Set.zip).

sources.name: Freesound
sources.license: Per sound: CC0-1.0, CC-BY-3.0/4.0, CC-BY-NC (reject), Sampling+ (legacy, reject)
sources.attribution_format: "<title>" by <creator> (<freesound page url>) is licensed under CC BY <version>
sources.redistribution_allowed: CC0: yes. CC BY: yes, if the credit travels with the file. NC: excluded.
sources.api: APIv2 needs a free API key (token) for search and previews; downloading originals (Download Sound / Download Pack) is OAuth2 required. Preview MP3s (cdn.freesound.org/previews/...-hq.mp3, ~128 kbps) need no auth.
sources.notes: Largest CC0 SFX pool. Filter with license:"Creative Commons 0" in the API. All 135 catalog sounds use the hq preview URL, which is good enough for video mixing; fetch the original WAV via OAuth2 when quality matters. Licenses spot-checked on 10 Freesound pages on 10.11.2026; all matched Openverse metadata.

sources.name: Openverse (audio index of Freesound, Wikimedia, Jamendo, ccMixter)
sources.license: Per item (CC0, PDM, CC BY, BY-SA, NC, ND); filter with license=cc0 or license=cc0,by
sources.commercial: Per item; cc0 and by are safe
sources.attribution_required: Per item; each result carries a ready 'attribution' string
sources.api: https://api.openverse.org/v1/audio/?q=<term>&license=cc0&page_size=20 . No key. Anonymous limits (response headers, 10.11.2026): 20 requests/min burst, 200/day sustained, page_size max 20. Register an OAuth app at /v1/auth_tokens/register/ for more. NOTE: category=sound_effect currently returns 0 results (category is null on Freesound items), so do not pass it.
sources.notes: Easiest keyless path to direct file URLs plus license metadata. Results include duration (ms), filetype, tags, creator, foreign_landing_url and alt_files (original WAV link, which needs Freesound OAuth2).

sources.name: OpenGameArt.org
sources.license: Per asset: CC0, CC BY 3.0/4.0, CC BY-SA (reject), GPL (reject), OGA-BY
sources.attribution_required: CC BY only (see each page's 'Attribution Instructions')
sources.attribution_format: Per page, e.g. "Sounds by Little Robot Sound Factory (www.littlerobotsoundfactory.com), CC BY 3.0"
sources.redistribution_allowed: CC0 yes; CC BY yes with credit
sources.api: No API. Stable direct zip URLs under https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/<name>.zip; no auth or cookies.
sources.notes: Game-oriented, but has strong CC0 packs: SubspaceAudio 512 retro SFX, rubberduck's 100 CC0 SFX v1/v2 and 50 retro synth SFX, Kenney mirrors. Check the license field on each page; many audio entries are BY-SA.

sources.name: Mixkit Sound Effects
sources.api: No API. Per-sound MP3 links on assets.mixkit.co are scrapeable but not a documented interface.
sources.notes: Commercial video use allowed without attribution; Mixkit's FAQ says YouTube video use is fine. Raw files may not be redistributed or re-hosted without significant changes. Download on demand only. Curated and polished (transitions, whooshes, UI). The full license text loads in a JS modal and could not be read directly on 10.11.2026; the summary comes from Mixkit's own pages and search snippets.

sources.name: Pixabay Sound Effects
sources.api: Pixabay API (https://pixabay.com/api/docs/) covers images and videos only; no audio endpoint. Site downloads sit behind Cloudflare and need a browser.
sources.notes: Free use without attribution; the license bans selling or distributing content 'on a Standalone basis' (unmodified), so a public repo of raw files breaks it. Brand or trademark content cannot be used commercially. Quality varies; many uploads are AI or reuploads, so check provenance for commercial clients.

sources.name: ZapSplat
sources.attribution_required: Yes for free (Basic) members; no for Premium/Gold; no for CC0-tagged items
sources.api: No public API; login required to download.
sources.notes: Large professional library (UI, whooshes, ambiences). Commercial OK under the Standard License; Basic accounts must credit ZapSplat. No re-hosting of raw files. License page returned 403 to automated fetch on 10.11.2026; terms taken from ZapSplat FAQ and license search results.

sources.name: Sonniss GDC Game Audio Bundle
sources.api: No API. Multi-GB zip parts per year (2015-2024, ~207 GB total), plus torrents and mirrors.
sources.notes: Pro-grade WAVs (impacts, whooshes, risers, ambiences) with a lifetime commercial license; attribution 'appreciated, never required'. Raw or edited files may not be redistributed as sound effects. AI/ML training is prohibited. Too big for on-demand fetching; better as a one-time local cache the skill points to.

sources.name: 99Sounds
sources.api: No API; zip downloads per library (some via email or third-party hosts).
sources.notes: Free sound-design libraries (cinematic hits, glitch, risers, foley). Commercial and client work allowed; credit optional. Redistributing the audio files 'even for free' is prohibited. Noise, white-noise and sleep apps are excluded.

sources.name: SoundBible
sources.license: Mixed per sound: Public Domain, CC BY 3.0, Sampling Plus 1.0, Personal Use Only
sources.commercial: Only Public Domain and CC BY 3.0 items
sources.redistribution_allowed: Public Domain and CC BY items only
sources.api: No API; direct mp3/wav links per page.
sources.notes: Small and dated. The about page says free sounds are commercial-safe only under CC BY or Public Domain. Filter each item; skip Sampling Plus and Personal Use Only. Some creator metadata is unreliable, so treat it as a low-priority source.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons (audio)
sources.license: Per file: PD, CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA (reject)
sources.commercial: PD, CC0 and CC BY files
sources.attribution_format: Per file page ('Use this file' credit line)
sources.redistribution_allowed: PD/CC0 yes; CC BY yes with credit
sources.api: MediaWiki API (no key), e.g. https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&list=categorymembers&cmtitle=Category:Sound_effects ; also indexed by Openverse.
sources.notes: Useful for public-domain field recordings and historical audio. Many files are CC BY-SA, so check each one. Openverse results from Wikimedia include Lingua Libre word pronunciations (titles 'LL-Q...'), which are noise for SFX searches.

sources.name: Adobe Audition sound effects
sources.api: No API; large zip downloads by category from the Adobe page.
sources.notes: Thousands of uncompressed royalty-free SFX (foliage, impacts, transitions, ambiences). Usable inside productions; the raw effects may not be distributed. Not verified from the EULA text itself on 10.11.2026; the summary rests on Adobe's offer page and Adobe community answers. Read the EULA before client work.

sources.name: BBC Sound Effects (RemArc)
sources.notes: REJECTED: RemArc excludes commercial use. Commercial licensing of the BBC library goes through Pro Sound Effects (paid).
